description: This PHP file contains a unit test class `LeaveEntitlementAPIEndpointTest` for the LeaveEntitlement API in the OrangeHRM system. It tests the creation of leave entitlements and validation rules for the LeaveEntitlement API endpoint, including fixture loading and mock service interactions.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPIEndpointTest
